title: Grid-following inverter
description: PLL-behind current source (wind, solar, HVDC, distributed generation): fast frequency response, loss-of-mains trips, impedance-scan and RMS-model parameters. Parameter names are the v1 AssetParams names where one exists. Omitted for want of a unit: the RMS active-current recovery rate RampUpPuPerSecond (pu/s; record default 10.0): NOT DECLARED (finding for Mark): the closed unit vocabulary has no unit for pu/s, so the parameter cannot be declared without inventing or misstating a unit. rocofGainMwsPerHz, fastSlewUpMwPerSPerMw / fastSlewDownMwPerSPerMw and dcVoltageV were unit gaps until Q24 (2026-10) added MW.s/Hz, MW/s/MW and V to the vocabulary; they are declared below.

deadbandHz.description: Frequency deadband before the fast frequency response acts (Hz).

droopGainMwPerHzPerMw.description: Frequency droop gain, MW/Hz per MW of rating.

rocofGainMwsPerHz.description: Synthetic-inertia (RoCoF) gain of the fast frequency response: MW delivered per Hz/s of measured df/dt, so MW.s/Hz. 0 or absent = no RoCoF leg (droop only).

detectionLatencyS.description: Frequency detection latency (s) before the response starts. The small-signal block derives a PLL bandwidth 1/(2 pi latency) from it when pllBandwidthHz is absent.

actuateTauS.description: First-order actuation time constant of the power response (s).

dispatchRampMwPerMin.description: Dispatch ramp rate (MW/min). Refused at load since R073 (October 2026): no controller has a dispatch setpoint to ramp (the inverters model the response about a fixed dispatch). The observed fleet ramp band the bundled v1 classes carried was removed from the data and is recorded in docs/technical/0013 Asset-dynamics data grounding.md.

fastSlewUpMwPerSPerMw.description: Upward slew-rate limit of the fast frequency response, MW/s per MW of rating. 0 or absent = no upward ramp limit.

fastSlewDownMwPerSPerMw.description: Downward slew-rate limit of the fast frequency response, MW/s per MW of rating. 0 or absent = no downward ramp limit.

headroomUpFraction.description: Upward response headroom as a fraction of rating.

headroomDownFraction.description: Downward response headroom as a fraction of rating.

rocofTripHzPerS.description: Loss-of-mains RoCoF trip threshold (Hz/s); absent = never trips on RoCoF.

rocofTripConfirmS.description: Definite-time confirmation delay of the RoCoF trip (s).

codeDefaults.consumer: GridFollowingInverter controller: absent => AssetParamDefaults.RocofTripConfirmS, 0.5 s (EREC G99 Issue 2 Table 10.1 LoM (RoCoF) time delay; R137, B4 October 2026: one default for both inverter kinds)

localRocofUpliftFactor.description: Ratio of local (sub-cycle) RoCoF to the centre-of-inertia RoCoF; 1 = no uplift.

vectorShiftTripDeg.description: Vector-shift loss-of-mains trip threshold (deg); absent = never trips on vector shift.

lvrtVoltagePu.description: Low-voltage ride-through trip level (pu of nominal voltage); 0 = never trips on voltage.

minOutputFraction.description: Minimum output as a fraction of rating. Refused at load since R073 (October 2026): no controller reads it.

pllBandwidthHz.description: SRF-PLL bandwidth (Hz). Opt-in: read only by the impedance scan and the modal (small-signal) model, never by the time-domain controller. One code default for all three converter models since R138 (October 2026, stream B5): ConverterDefaults.PllBandwidthHz = 20 Hz (the impedance and small-signal placeholders were 5 Hz).

codeDefaults.consumer: ConverterDefaults.PllBandwidthHz, read by: the EMT average-value converter (ThreePhaseConverter record default); GridFollowingImpedance (impedance scan) placeholder when the class has none (also repeated by CliDefaults.PlaceholderPllBandwidthHz); LinearInverterModel.ForGfl small-signal fallback when neither pllBandwidthHz nor a usable detectionLatencyS is set

pllDampingRatio.description: SRF-PLL damping ratio. Opt-in: read by the impedance scan and (since R138, October 2026, stream B5) the modal (small-signal) model. Default 0.707 for a PLL in every model; the small-signal stand-in for a detection delay (bandwidth from detectionLatencyS) is critically damped (1.0) unless this key is authored.

codeDefaults.consumer: ConverterDefaults.PllDampingRatio, read by: the EMT converter PI loop; the GridFollowingImpedance placeholder; LinearInverterModel.ForGfl when its bandwidth is a PLL's (pllBandwidthHz authored, or the 20 Hz placeholder): the one PLL default
LinearInverterModel.ForGfl small-signal estimator, delay stand-in only (bandwidth 1/(2 pi detectionLatencyS), no pllDampingRatio authored): critically damped

currentLoopBandwidthHz.description: Inner current-loop bandwidth (Hz); absent or 0 = current loop not modelled in the impedance scan.

faultCurrentPu.description: Converter fault-current multiple k (x rated current), IEC 60909 I_skPF = k I_rG; 0 = feeds no fault current.

codeDefaults.consumer: RmsConverterParameters Imax record default (RMS converter current limit)

rmsCurrentLagS.description: REGC_A current-command lag Tg (s) of the RMS converter model.

rmsDipVoltagePu.description: Voltage below which the RMS dip logic is active (pu).

rmsReactiveCurrentGain.description: K-factor reactive-current boost on a voltage dip, pu current per pu voltage.

rmsLvacmZeroPu.description: REGC_A LVACM: active current is zero at or below this terminal voltage (pu).

rmsLvacmFullPu.description: REGC_A LVACM: active current is unrestricted at or above this terminal voltage (pu).

rmsDipHoldS.description: Time the RMS dip logic stays active after the voltage recovers (s).

rmsBlockInDip.description: Line-commutated HVDC terminal: feeds no current during a dip (commutation failure / blocking).

capacityFactor.description: Representative capacity factor used to turn nameplate into a snapshot dispatch, by technology. FuelMap (GDA build), Dispatcher (Core) and SyntheticGb disagree (inconsistency register).

capacityMwh.description: Usable energy (MWh) of the DC store behind the converter; 0 or absent = unbounded (no store). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

socInit.description: Initial state of charge (fraction of capacityMwh). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

socMin.description: Lower state-of-charge bound of the simple SoC bucket (used when no chemistry is set). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

socMax.description: Upper state-of-charge bound of the simple SoC bucket (used when no chemistry is set). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

batteryChemistry.description: Chemistry pack behind the converter. v1 stores a numeric code (0 or absent = none, 1 LFP, 2 NMC, 3 LTO, 4 Na-ion, 5 VRFB, 6 lead-acid; DcSources.ChemistryFromCode); v2 names it. No codeDefault: the v1 fallback is the numeric code 0, which is not one of these names. Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

dcVoltageV.description: DC pack voltage (V) of the battery store behind the converter, used to size the series cell count. Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind. The 1500 V ceiling is the low-voltage DC limit that utility battery packs are built to.

converterEfficiency.description: One-way converter efficiency between the chemistry pack and the grid. Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

ambientC.description: Ambient temperature of the chemistry pack (degC). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.
